Remark 1. In the ﬁeld of p-adic numbers Qp, the p-adic absolute value |x|p of
a nonzero element x is deﬁned as:
|x|p = p−vp(x),
where vp(x) is the p-adic valuation of x. The valuation vp(x) is the highest
power of p that divides x in Qp.

possible values of |x|p in this case are:
